rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Bitvoya enables AI agents to search premium hotels, compare rates with structured benefit details (breakfast, upgrades, credits), prepare booking quotes, and hand off to a secure Bitvoya checkout flow. The server manages payment and card data on Bitvoya-owned infrastructure. Requires a Bearer token agent key from the Bitvoya dashboard.
